# Step AD: several scripts

Lex (2026-11-19, Orbit TOOLS-358, prototype TOOLS-356 approved in its final state): while I write one script, my AI works on others. Switching stays in the file name's menu, with no tabs and no side-by-side view. Each script keeps its scroll place and caret. While the AI works in another script, that menu row shows a spinner and "AI working"; when it is done, the row gets an orange dot (no number) and "AI done", and the same dot shows on the file name. The open script never gets a dot. A click opens the script at the change, lightly marked, with Undo on the agent's tag; the dot goes once the change has been seen. The dot stays clearly apart from the orange "not saved yet" dot by its position, as in the prototype.

## What it does

- **Scripts kept aside** (`public/aside.js`, new, pure). Leaving a script (any way: the menu, Open a script, New script, the agent's `open_script`) keeps where it was scrolled and its caret (by line and offset, so it also fits the script read again from its file). When the agent still works on an ask on selected words there (waiting or taken; not B-roll asks, not whole-script jobs), or it holds an agent change not seen yet, the script itself stays in the tab's memory: its document, asks and undo steps. Only a script in a file (on the computer or in the browser) is kept, since the answer must reach its file.
- **The answer lands there.** `wait_for_asks` hands the agent the asks of scripts kept aside too, each with its script's `fileName`; `answer_ask` for one of them (an ask on selected words; a whole-script job or a B-roll ask there is told to wait until the person opens that script, and stays as it is) is checked as usual against that script and lands in it as in the open script (step F): one undo step for when the person is back, lightly marked, Undo on the agent's tag; a note waits beside its text; links go in as for a selection. Other open asks and earlier marks in that paragraph follow the change. Nothing in the open script is touched: no render, no caret, no scroll, no undo step, no room message.
- **Its own file.** `saving.saveLeft` (new in `saving.js`) writes the kept script's words to its own file with the auto-save rules: no permission prompt, and the changed-on-disk check. While a save runs it waits in the queue like any script left behind (`SaveQueue.queueLeft`), after an older write of the same file, and is compared with what that write left. A file changed elsewhere is never written over: the words wait as a draft. `on.left` tells the app what a left file now holds, so the next write and the reopen compare with the right words. The kept script's draft holds its asks and the agent's marked change, so they come back after a reload too.
- **Opening it again.** From the menu (or any other way) a kept script takes no answer while it opens (the agent hears it is opening and to answer again in a moment), leaves the list once its file has been read, and opens as it is in memory, with its undo steps, after its last write has landed, unless its file holds other words by then: then it opens from its file like any other. An answer that could not be written because the file had changed shows there as "Unsaved changes" (Restore brings it back); words the agent already saved that someone wrote over later are gone, as for any saved file. With a change not seen yet it opens at that change (30 % from the top), otherwise at its scroll place with its caret. A change counts as seen once it has been on screen below the top bar; leaving before that keeps its dot.
- **The menu and the dot** (prototype, final state). A kept script's row shows a small spinner and "AI working" while the agent works there, then "AI done" and an orange dot; the open script's row never has either. The same dot sits at the file name's top corner (`#aiDot`, 0.62 rem, raised by 0.38 rem, with a ring in the page colour) while any kept script is done and not seen; the "not saved yet" dot stays 7 px, beside the name, outside the button. Screen readers hear "AI done in another script" on the dot and "<agent> is done in <file>" once (a polite live region). The spinner and the dot's arrival move only when motion is allowed.

- **Taken off the list.** Deleting a kept browser script drops it from memory (its dot goes); its writes on their way, the agent's and the save made when it was left, end first and none follows, so no draft comes back under its name (second look on PR #76). Taking a kept file off the switcher's list with ×, or a kept file falling off the list of 20, drops it from memory too; its file stays, and answers already on their way still reach it one after the other, with its draft. A "/" command being typed when the script is left stays out of it, as it stays out of every save.
- **Opening twice at once** (review round 2): while a kept script opens it takes no answer, and a second open of it (the person's click while the agent's `open_script` runs) waits for the first; the agent's `open_script` for a script the person opened meanwhile says it is already open and reads nothing again (round 3).
- **A Save as at the same moment** (review round 1, P2): a Save as or a save into the browser that runs while an answer lands in a kept script now writes that script's words to its own file before it ends; before, the queue was cleared and opening that script waited for good.

- **Its own save still waiting** (second look, P1): a script left while its own auto-save runs has its newer words waiting for that save; an answer that lands then is newer still and wins, so the older words never overwrite it (`SaveQueue.queueLeft`). A `saveLeft` call hears it is done only from the write of its own words (or newer ones merged into them), never from an older write of the same file still on its way (second look on 97954a7, P1). A change, or a caret, in the folded lines at the top opens them when the script opens there (second look, P2).

- **Opens one at a time** (second look on f7f7ce9, P1): every open waits for the one before it. An open that finds its file opened meanwhile by the one before reads nothing again (so the agent's change keeps its undo step), and a script being deleted does not open; the delete waits for every save of it with `saving.idle()` (new). A kept file drops from memory only when it falls off a list that was really read (with storage off, nothing is dropped), and a script deleted while it opens shows no "Couldn't open". Every open checks once more, right before it shows the script, that the file is not being deleted (a script that was not kept too); `idle()` also waits for a `saveLeft` write running outside the queue; and an answer that changes a line a B-roll shot covers gives that shot "Check", as the person's own edit does, through the B-roll part (`touchKept`, seam 2; second look on 437c1d2 and the review on 4a0cb63). Opening a kept script also waits for the save made when it was left; `idle()` waits through a save that was waiting behind the running one; a script left while a "/" command is typed is kept without its undo steps, which may hold parts of the command (as when any script is left; second look on 1068e69).

## Checks

- `tests/aside.test.mjs`: keeping a script aside, landing a replace (marked, one undo step, the open script untouched), other asks and marks following, a gone quote cancelled, a note, the asks offered to the agent, the caret by line and offset, and the dot's size and place.
- `tests/saving.test.mjs`: `saveLeft` writes with the auto-save rules and says so; waits for a running save and compares with what it left; never writes over a file changed on disk; still reaches its file during a Save as or a save into the browser.
- `scripts/smoke-several-scripts.mjs`: the whole flow in headless Chrome at 1280 px and 390 px with the agent played over `/mcp` and two made-up scripts: the ask, "AI working", typing in the open script while the answer lands (same scroll, caret and text), the file of the other script, the dot (bigger and higher than the not-saved dot), "AI done", opening at the marked change, Undo on the agent's tag, Undo by Ctrl+Z on the phone run, the first script back at its place with its caret, the change still marked after a reload, an answer that meets a file changed elsewhere (not written over; "Unsaved changes" with Restore), and deleting a script the agent just worked in (its dot, row, file and draft go; the agent gets none of its asks). Evidence: `docs/agents/evidence/step-ad-browser.txt`.
